content:
The leaf shows a dark, mottled, sooty appearance covering the entire leaf surface with a blackish-gray powdery or crusty coating. There are no discrete lesions or necrotic spots typical of Anthracnose. No die-back (tip/margin browning progressing inward). No white powdery patches typical of Powdery Mildew. Instead, the dark, soot-like coating uniformly covering the leaf surface is characteristic of Sooty Mould, which grows on honeydew secretions and produces a black fungal layer on leaf surfaces.
